propositions: Push non-fast-forward recovery fails permanently when an untracked local file collides with a file the merge wants to create, aborting the merge and giving up instead of self-healing like reconverge does.
The recovery must quarantine named untracked colliding paths (parsed from git merge abort output) into a shared directory, retry the merge once, and restore the stash exactly once on all exit paths.

Untracked-overwrite recovery reuses the shared parser from sync._untracked_overwrite_paths and shares the quarantine directory shape via sync._quarantine_dir_under, but implements the move operation locally in push_recovery through core._git to preserve the module's monkeypatch boundary.

Genuine merge conflicts and unnamed paths must retain today's behavior (abort, restore stash, warn/strict-raise); the quarantine move is fenced by git status --porcelain -uall '??' to prevent relocation of tracked data.
